caption:
Stock market news | SEBI aims to deepen capital markets for 2x economy

On 28 November 2026, SEBI Chairman Pandey announced that the regulator will work to deepen capital markets and simplify regulations. These steps aim to attract more investment and help India achieve a *2x* economy, boosting growth and market depth.
